descriptionChirho: To experience inner turmoil, agitation, or distress, used of persons who are disturbed, frightened, or deeply unsettled in their hearts or minds.
To disturb, unsettle, or throw into confusion other people, often by spreading false teaching or creating social upheaval.
To agitate or set in motion a body of water, referring to the physical disturbance of the pool of Bethesda.
